name: Valaran Stormcaller

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.description: A charged heavy melee attack that deals high physical damage and knocking the target back. This attack should be blocked or dodged if possible.

abilities.name: Enervating Bolt
abilities.description: The boss shoots a bolt of lightning that deals moderate shock damage and stuns the target. Break free to counter this.

abilities.name: Summon Lightning Avatar
abilities.description: The boss summons a Lightning Avatar to attack the party. This should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: A Storm will continuously roam the arena at random, dealing shock damage over time to all players as indicated by a red circle.

Pledge: Tempest Island: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Tempest Island.
summary: Valaran Stormcaller is a Maormer found at Tempest Island, of which he is a boss. He has a chance to drop Stormcaller's Blade. A "Sudden Storm" summoned near him will move around the room, electrocuting those who touch it, and should be avoided.
